consumers.name: GoreeCloud Launcher
consumers.visualAcceptance: phone/tablet native, rendered, and physical-device acceptance remain pending
consumers.notes: Launcher maps the current consumed spacing, radius, touch-target, material-hierarchy, and native-control semantics to Jetpack Compose and enforces its mapped token/evidence subset with scripts/check_glaze_ui.py. This remains partial application-specific adoption evidence, not a full Glaze UI 1.4 conformance claim.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Notes
consumers.visualAcceptance: real-device/network Glaze UI performance and accessibility acceptance remains pending
consumers.notes: The active native-foundation draft line vendors the canonical Glaze UI 1.0 web foundation locally and validates that foundation in CI. The consumer remains a development candidate and is not production accepted.

consumers.name: GoreeCloud Monitor
consumers.visualAcceptance: target-environment rendered/accessibility and production acceptance remain pending
consumers.notes: The active stable-foundation draft line implements a repository-local Glaze UI application layer with automated source and runtime validation. Uptime Kuma remains production until Monitor completes target-environment acceptance and cutover governance.
